items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: But I used to heard your talk of Roy, but I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Roy Palmer, did you ever hear him play? He went to Chicago very early, Roy Palmer. He was the pupil of Jim Humphrey too.
Yeah. Roy Palmer. But I used to heard your talk of Roy, but I didn't know him. Didn't know him?
No. He went up with Lawrence Dilley and Sugar Johnny.
